findings.body: Supported answers always have a dimension, so the real `SelectionExecutor` invokes `beforeExecute` once for the primary query and again for the totals query (`backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts:80-92`). This assignment therefore replaces the pre-primary pin snapshot. If a noncontributing month reloads after the primary query but before totals, the second lookup and final lookup both see the replacement; because primary provenance contains no pin for that month, `completeActualPins` reports no change and signs the replacement. A zero-net replacement can then make a formerly budget-only row drillable and open transactions not behind the displayed answer. The new fixture misses this because its fake executor calls `beforeExecute` only once (`chat.service.test.ts:1921-1925`). Preserve the first snapshot across the complete execution or bracket the primary query explicitly.
findings.title: Pin snapshot is overwritten before the totals query

findings.body: `activeBatchIds` contains provenance collected from returned answer rows, not every active batch in the window (`backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:70-75`). Consequently, when the final-month budget batch exists but contributes no selected row, this lookup returns no budget pin. Statement labels then remain raw even though the final outline exists, and issued contexts omit the required budget pin/digest; multi-period GL budget fallback has the same problem when only an earlier month contributes. The tests fabricate the final budget pin in `activeBatchIds`, so they do not exercise this case. Resolve the final-month active budget batch independently and bracket it consistently with execution.
findings.title: Final-month budget pin is still inferred only from contributing rows

findings.body: The new size-limit rule at lines 71-74 says an oversized row carries no amount, but this generic description still says every row binds its exact-paise Actual, and C5a at lines 223-224 repeats that each row carries one. Those requirements remain mutually exclusive despite the implementation's discriminated union. Explicitly exempt the C5d inert variant in both generic descriptions.
